description: Lets the app read a file that was opened with MidNote from the phone's "Open with" list (a content:// address). fs:allow-open + fs:allow-read only: NO path scope is granted, and for a content:// address the fs plugin does not use one, so ordinary file paths stay unreadable. Android only: the file is handed over by the deep-link plugin, which is a mobile-only dependency.
